name: SkillQuiz Arena
prompt:
Build a vibrant, colorful, Play-Store-grade Quiz & Daily Challenge app named SkillQuiz Arena using royal blue, violet, gold and emerald gradients. Keep it 100% legal with free virtual points (zero real-money betting).
1. TAB 1 (#view-1 Home): Colorful greeting with user's Points & Rank, a Daily Challenge banner, 4 Quiz Category cards (Tech, Cricket, GK, Math) where tapping any card opens a full interactive 5-question Quiz inside #view-detail via FactoryNav.openDetail() with timer, score calculation, Confetti on win, and points saved via FactoryDB.recordTx().
2. TAB 2 (#view-2 Arena & Custom): Create & save custom Quiz Flashcards/Notes to the 4th cloud table using FactoryDB.saveItem('quiz_note', title, data) and list them via FactoryDB.getItems('quiz_note'), filterable by #app-search-bar. Tapping #floating-cta (+) opens a modal to quickly add a new custom question or claim Daily Check-in +50 Points.
3. TAB 3 (#view-3 Leaderboard & Chart): Live Top Players Leaderboard fetched from FactoryDB.getLeaderboard(), plus a colorful weekly Points Chart using Chart.js.
4. TAB 4 (#view-4 Profile & Certificate): Show saved Name, Mobile, Points, Transaction History from FactoryDB.getTransactions(), a "Download Winner Certificate PDF" button using FactoryUI.downloadPDF(), a "Share Score on WhatsApp" button (https://wa.me/?text=...), and Log Out.
